title: From Shared Patterns to Individual Evidence: Two-Stage Reasoning for Emerging Entities in Temporal Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.34708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) continually introduce emerging entities whose interaction histories evolve from zero-shot debuts into sparse, bursty few-shot trajectories. However, current paradigms are fragmented: pattern-transfer methods lack catalog-wide event memory, whereas online memory models suffer from endpoint-role asymmetry that degrades unseen-answer ranking. Furthermore, sparse early interactions exhibit both long-range dispersion and local redundancy under skewed distribution. To address these challenges, we propose INSPIRE (Integrating Shared Patterns and Individual Evidence for Reasoning), a two-stage forecasting framework over a known catalog. In Stage I, INSPIRE learns an availability-aware shared-pattern predictor that fuses event-updated memory across the full candidate catalog while applying coordinated query- and catalog-side masking. translated_title: 从共享模式到个体证据：时序知识图谱中新兴实体的两阶段推理
translated_abstract: 时序知识图谱（TKG）持续引入新兴实体，这些实体的交互历史会从零样本的初次登场逐步演变为稀疏且突发性的少样本轨迹。然而，现有研究范式较为割裂：模式迁移方法缺乏覆盖完整实体目录的事件记忆，而在线记忆模型则存在端点角色不对称问题，导致对未见答案的排序性能下降。此外，稀疏的早期交互在偏斜分布下同时表现出长程分散性与局部冗余性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了INSPIRE（Integrating Shared Patterns and Individual Evidence for Reasoning，融合共享模式与个体证据的推理框架），一个面向已知实体目录的两阶段预测框架。在第一阶段，INSPIRE学习一个具备可用性感知能力的共享模式预测器，该预测器融合跨完整候选目录的事件更新记忆，并采用查询侧与目录侧协同掩码机制。随后，在第二阶段，该预测器被冻结，并在其基础上优化一个轻量级的个体……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出INSPIRE两阶段推理框架，通过融合全目录事件记忆的共享模式预测与轻量级个体证据建模，有效解决时序知识图谱中新兴实体从零样本到少样本演化场景下的链接预测难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes INSPIRE, a two-stage reasoning framework that combines an availability-aware shared-pattern predictor with full-catalog event memory and lightweight individual evidence modeling to improve forecasting for emerging entities in temporal knowledge graphs.
